Package ro.ubb.map.retea.repository

Interface Repository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>

Type Parameters:
ID - the type of the id
E - the type of the entity
All Known Implementing Classes:
FileRepository, InMemoryRepository, PrietenieDbRepository, UtilizatorDbRepository
public interface Repository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>
CRUD contract for entities identified by an ID. Operations that may have no result return Optional instead of null.

  • Method Details

    • findOne

      Optional<E> findOne(ID id)
      Finds an entity by id.
      Parameters:
      id - the id to look for; cannot be null
      Returns:
      the entity with the given id, or an empty Optional if it does not exist
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the id is null
      RepositoryException - if the persistent storage cannot be read

      Returns:

    • save

      Optional<E> save(E entity)
      Saves an entity after validating it.
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity to save; cannot be null
      Returns:
      an empty Optional if the entity was saved, otherwise the existing entity (the id already exists)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the entity is null
      ValidationException - if the entity is not valid
      RepositoryException - if the persistent storage cannot be read or written

    • delete

      Optional<E> delete(ID id)
      Deletes the entity with the given id.
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the entity; cannot be null
      Returns:
      the deleted entity, or an empty Optional if it does not exist
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the id is null
      RepositoryException - if the persistent storage cannot be read or written

    • update

      Optional<E> update(E entity)
      Updates an existing entity (with the same id), after validating it.
      Parameters:
      entity - the new version of the entity; cannot be null
      Returns:
      an empty Optional if the entity was updated, otherwise the given entity (the id does not exist)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the entity is null
      ValidationException - if the entity is not valid
      RepositoryException - if the persistent storage cannot be read or written

    • stream

      default Stream<E> stream()
      Returns the entities as a new sequential stream. This is the only place where the Iterable returned by findAll() is turned into a stream. A stream can be consumed only once, so every call builds a fresh one.
      Returns:
      a stream over a snapshot of all the entities
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the persistent storage cannot be read

    • findAll

      default List<E> findAll(Predicate<E> filter)
      Returns the entities that satisfy a criterion, in the order of findAll(). Criteria are built outside the repository (see CriteriiUtilizator) and can be combined with Predicate.and(Predicate), Predicate.or(Predicate) and Predicate.negate().
      Parameters:
      filter - the criterion an entity must satisfy; cannot be null
      Returns:
      a new list with the matching entities, empty if there are none
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the filter is null
      RepositoryException - if the persistent storage cannot be read
